label: train.py
content:
import yaml
from peft import LoraConfig, get_peft_model
from src.model import build_backbone
from src.ckpt import load_resume, save_resume

def main(cfg_path):
    cfg = yaml.safe_load(open(cfg_path))
    model = build_backbone(cfg["model"])
    lora = LoraConfig(r=cfg["lora"]["rank"],
                      lora_alpha=cfg["lora"]["alpha"])
    model = get_peft_model(model, lora)
    start = load_resume(cfg["output_dir"])  # 재개용 체크포인트
    for epoch in range(start, cfg["train"]["epochs"]):
        train_one_epoch(model, epoch)
        save_resume(model, epoch, cfg["output_dir"])
